name: From the Sun to the Moon
source:
Soleil and her girlfriend Esmeray have been together for almost three years! Leading up to their third year anniversary, Soleil decides the best way to celebrate would be to take Esmeray out on a date each day leading up to their anniversary! Will the dates be successful, or end in total failure?

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230921231908/https://smilestrawbunny.itch.io/from-the-sun-to-the-moon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Soleil和她的女朋友Esmeray已经在一起快三年了！在他们的三周年纪念日到来之前，Soleil决定最好的庆祝方式是在他们的周年纪念日之前每天带Esmeray出去约会！约会会成功还是以彻底失败告终？

[编辑自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230921231908/https://smilestrawbunny.itch.io/from-the-sun-to-the-moon]Itch.io[/url]]
